name: Busa Support
description: Customer-support desk: tickets, knowledge base, and the support-qa quality gate

agentPrompts.label: Summarize queue health
agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `busa-support` skill in this folder, then open the overview and summarize open, breaching-SLA, and awaiting-approval ticket counts, the CSAT trend, and volume by channel and category.

agentPrompts.label: Review the approval queue
agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `busa-support` skill in this folder and follow its workflow, then walk me through the tickets waiting on my decision so I can approve, request changes, or block each drafted reply — nothing sends until I approve, and a support-qa BLOCK verdict can't be approved until it's fixed.

agentPrompts.label: Triage the latest incoming tickets
agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `busa-support` skill in this folder and follow its workflow, then collect and triage the latest incoming tickets across channels, draft KB-grounded replies with a proposed action for each, and get them ready for my review.
